name: pdlc-agnostic
description: Architecture-agnostic PDLC meta-builder for Claude Code and Claude Cowork. One Discover, Deliver, Evolve process spine with human-in-the-loop gates, append-only logs, a build-time CTO reviewer agent, and pluggable Target and Shipping adapters. Supports provisioning, rediscovery, fork-with-lineage, and class-aware migration including shadow or strangler coexistence and a decommission gate.
